note: Committed input of tools.performance_lever_heatmap. Each lever names the profiled code it replaces; a function counts only in the workloads it lists. 'cumulative' = the Python subtree, 'self' = self time (native calls are invisible to cProfile and charge their time to the calling wrapper's self time). Within a lever no listed function may lie inside another's counted time; the tool checks that against the call graph. A wired lever's cell is the time its replacement still costs on the generation path.
